summary: Create project-scoped webhook mesh to route Jira events across pods for multi-team incident escalations
description: Issue summary: Multiple pods need a reliable, project-scoped way to forward and transform Jira issue events (create, update, comment, transitions) to other internal Jira projects, Slack channels, and Confluence pages for coordinated incident escalations. Impact: During high-severity incidents the current ad-hoc webhooks and channel-level integrations cause missed handoffs, duplicate notifications, and manual cross-posting, slowing MTTR. Environment: Production Jira instance, multiple internal projects across runtime-ops, platform, and model-eval pods. Steps to reproduce: 1) Trigger an incident in runtime-ops project (manual label + transition). 2) Observe that webhook for runtime-ops is sent only to a single downstream listener; other pods rely on manual Slack pings. 3) Attempt to programmatically route event to platform on-call project; requires creating and managing separate webhooks per project and per consumer. Observed failure modes: rate-limited webhooks, fragile secret management, inconsistent event filtering, and missing context when cross-posts occur. Desired outcome: A lightweight mesh/relay pattern where project-scoped webhook rules can route, enrich, and deliver events to multiple targets (Jira projects, Slack channels, Confluence pages, and an internal incident-bus) with centralized auth, per-route rate-limits, retry semantics, and audit logs. Scope: prototype relay + rule UI for two pilot pods (runtime-ops, platform), migration plan for 6 additional projects, and runbook for SREs.
steps_to_reproduce: Create a test incident issue in runtime-ops project and transition to 'Investigating'
Confirm existing webhook only posts to single listener and other pods receive no programmatic notification
Try to add another webhook for each consumer - observe secret sprawl and permission friction
desired_outcome: Implement a relay service (webhook-mesh) that accepts project-scoped subscriptions, supports event transforms, and publishes to multiple sinks with centralized secrets, retries, and observability. Provide pilot onboarding docs and a deprecation schedule for legacy webhooks.

resolution_plan: Phase 1 (prototype): deploy webhook-mesh in dev with two pilot routes and transform examples; Phase 2 (hardening): add per-subscription ACLs, audit events, retry and circuit-breaker logic; Phase 3 (pilot rollout): onboard runtime-ops and platform; Phase 4 (migration): schedule deprecation of legacy webhooks and migrate remaining projects. Follow-ups: add runbook, RBAC automation for onboarding, and cost/latency SLOs.
